destination_poi.description_summer: Risetestock is the western outcrop of the long Pilatus range, located above Gfellen, a small excursion place, and vis-à-vis Schimberig.

segments.description: From the Gfellen bus station follow a side road to Hintergfellen. There, take the marked hiking trail left to reach the farmhouse called Mittlisthütten.
segments.title: Gfellen – Mittlisthütten

segments.description: Immediately behind the farmhouse the hiking trail crosses a small ravine. On the other side leave the trail to the left and north-eastward ascend pathless in tiered, gentle pastures. At ca. 1410 m you reach the edge of the forest. Climb over the barbed wire fence. From here on, a distinct path zig-zags up the forest, mostly on a wide ridge. The terrain is steep, but never exposed. Here and there fallen trees need to be overcome. Further up, the slope flattens. At ca. 1510 m a clearing leads up to an open ridge, from where the summit area can be overlooked. Pathless ascend to a characteristic boulder, then descend to a grassy saddle and ascend again to the foot of a rocky ledge. A number of iron rungs help to overcome an overhanging rocky passage. There are also iron rungs in the steep grassy/schrofen slope that follows. They appear to be stable, but in fact they are fairly old, so that it is recommended to test their stability before stepping on them. At the end of this passage go right around a corner to reach the Risetestock summit.
segments.title: Mittlisthütten – Risetestock

segments.description: From Risetestock follow a good path towards Blaue Tosse. After a few minutes you reach a bifurcation, where you choose the ascending path on the right-hand side. Without further difficulties the marked path leads up to Blaue Tosse.
segments.title: Risetestock – Blaue Tosse

segments.description: From Blaue Tosse go back to the bifurcation, turn sharply right and descend Riseteflue. Some passages are equipped with fixed ropes. The first requires some scrambling (T3+), the others are just handrails in steep passages. From 1500 m on the trail becomes easier. It leads down to the Riseten farmhouse. From there follow small roads, agricultural roads and faint paths down to the road via Gfellenschilt. In a few minutes you reach the starting point Gfellen.
segments.title: Blaue Tosse – Gfellen

segments.description: From Blaue Tosse Stäfeliflue is reachable on a marked trail without any difficulties (T2, 45 Min. roundtrip).
segments.title: Variant: detour to Stäfeliflue

teaser: Risetestock and Blaue Tosse are often visited, but mainly on the marked trails. Here we present a more adventurous variant, a direct ascent from Gfellen to both summits.
title: Traverse from Gfellen to Blaue Tosse

reference_poi.description_summer: Zweitwestlichster Gipfel der Pilatuskette mit ausserordentlich schönem Blick ins Mittelland hinaus sowie zu den Berner Alpen. Bricht nach Nordwesten mit einer eindrücklichen, stellenweise überhängenden Felswand ab, während von Süden her die Legföhren fast bis zum höchsten Punkt reichen. Unmittelbar unter dem Gipfel Sitzbank und Feuerstelle. Im Gipfelbereich kommen mehrere markierte Bergwanderwege zusammen.
Höchste Erhebung der westlichen Pilatuskette. Ihr Name rührt daher, dass sie mit Flühen (= Felsbändern) Richtung Norden abbricht, zum Stäfeli.
reference_poi.description_winter: Westlichster mit Skis begehbarer Punkt im Pilatusmassiv.
